user.title: Travel Slideshow
user.description: Read-only access to a Google Drive photo folder through a service account. Share the folder with the service account's e-mail address as Viewer first, then paste the key file here.

data.service_account: Service account key (the whole JSON file)
data.root_folder_id: Drive folder ID (or the folder's web address)

data_description.service_account: Open the downloaded .json file in a text editor, select everything and paste it here. It is stored in this Home Assistant only.
data_description.root_folder_id: The part after /folders/ in the folder's address.
data_description.output_dir: Where the daily photos are written.

reconfigure.title: Replace the service account key
reconfigure.description: Paste the content of the new key file. The library and all marks are kept.

data.service_account: Service account key (the whole JSON file)

error.invalid_json: This is not valid JSON. Paste the entire contents of the key file.
error.invalid_key: This is not a service account key (it needs type, client_email and private_key).
error.invalid_folder_id: This does not look like a Drive folder ID.
error.auth_failed: Google refused the key. Check that it is the key of the right service account and has not been deleted.
error.folder_not_found: The folder was not found. Share it with the service account's e-mail address (Viewer) and check the ID.
error.not_a_folder: This ID is a file, not a folder.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Google Drive. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This folder is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The new key is in use.

init.title: Travel Slideshow options
init.description: Folder and file rules take one entry per line; formats are separated by commas. Photos are kept at their original size. Changes apply from the next scan or sync.

data.report_notify: Report recipients: e-mail addresses or notify services (one per line)
data.fails_before_push: Push after this many failed syncs in a row
data.show_date: Show: date and time of the photo
data.show_prev: Show: back button (swipe right also goes back)
data.show_pause: Show: pause button (a tap on the picture also pauses)
data.show_next: Show: next button (swipe left also goes on)
data.show_pause_symbol: Show: pause symbol in the corner while paused
data.show_counter: Show: small number of the item on screen in the top right corner (for example 12 / 50)
data.mode_folder: Mode video: folder with one <mode>.mp4 per mode
data.clean_entities: Exit mode: vacuum entities for "Cleaning: in progress" (one per line, empty = off)

data_description.photo_seconds: Videos always play to their end (up to the longest video setting). A change applies from the next photo on the slideshow page.
data_description.exclude_folders: Matched against every folder name on the way to a file. A plain word matches a whole word ("temp" matches "aaaa temp" but not "Temple"); entries with * ? [ ] are glob patterns.
data_description.photo_formats: File extensions separated by commas, for example: jpg, jpeg, png, heic, tif, bmp, gif
data_description.video_formats: File extensions separated by commas, for example: mp4, mov
data_description.exclude_files: Example: *_hide.* excludes IMG_1_hide.jpg. Rename a photo like that in Drive to remove it from the slideshow for good.
data_description.mode_entity: Optional. An input_text entity, for example input_text.video_mode. While its state is home the slideshow runs; for any other state (coffee, exit, sleep ...) the page plays <folder>/<state>.mp4 in a loop instead.
data_description.exit_helper: Optional. While this input_boolean is on and the mode is exit, the page shows a flip-clock countdown.
data_description.report_notify: An e-mail address (the report is e-mailed there) or a notify service such as notify.mobile_app_phone. Leave empty to send no report.

drive_access.title: Travel Slideshow cannot read Google Drive
drive_access.description:
The last scan failed: {error}

Check that the folder is still shared with the service account (Viewer) and that its key has not been deleted.

sync_failed.title: Travel Slideshow could not build today's slideshow
sync_failed.description:
The last sync failed: {error}

Yesterday's slideshow stays in place. It is retried at the next daily sync, or press "Sync slideshow now".
